levels.name: Paw Academy
levels.tagline: A quick practice course: walk, jump, sprint, climb and dodge. No rush, no rivals!
levels.label: Tutorial

levels.name: Candy Peak Rush
levels.tagline: Six sections, five checkpoints, one candy summit. Race to the top!

levels.name: Tumble Tower
levels.tagline: Find the hole on every floor and drop all the way to the bottom. Fastest wins!

levels.name: Speedway Scramble
levels.tagline: Race the pack around the beach track. Hit the boost pads - only half qualify!

levels.name: Hex Tumble
levels.tagline: Tiles vanish under your feet. Keep moving, drop layer to layer, survive 45 seconds!

levels.name: Perfect Match
levels.tagline: Memorise the symbols, then stand on the one the sign shows before the rest sink!

levels.name: Sweeper Showdown
levels.tagline: Two bars spin faster and faster while the ice shrinks. Survive 60 seconds!

levels.name: Coin Frenzy
levels.tagline: Grab 25 coins in 60 seconds. They respawn - bumpers and springs help (or not)!

levels.name: Hedge Maze
levels.tagline: Two mazes, one plaza of sweepers between them. Charge the chest walls for shortcuts!
levels.label: Maze race

levels.name: Door Dash
levels.tagline: Some doors burst open, some bounce you back. Pick fast - fewer real doors every row!
levels.label: Lucky doors

levels.name: Doodle Derby
levels.tagline: Run over the floor to paint it your color. Trace the gold doodle for triple points!
levels.label: Paint party

levels.name: Tip Toe Trail
levels.tagline: Only a hidden path of tiles is real. Watch who falls, follow who doesn’t!
levels.label: Hidden path

levels.name: Crown Clash
levels.tagline: Stand in the crown zone to score. It hops every 10s - first to 30 crown seconds!
levels.label: King of the hill

levels.name: Bomb Bash
levels.tagline: Holding a bomb? Tag someone before it blows! Three fuses - last ones standing win.

levels.name: Lava Rising
levels.tagline: The lava is rising! Hop up the spiral steps and hold the summit for 70 seconds.
levels.label: Rising lava

levels.name: Wall Rush
levels.tagline: Walls sweep the platform - slip through the gaps or get shoved off. Survive 60s!
levels.label: Dodge

levels.name: Midnight Match
levels.tagline: Perfect Match after dark: a bigger board, six rounds, and barely any time to look.
levels.label: Memory+

levels.name: Candy Factory
levels.tagline: Grab 30 coins off the belts, the spinners and the candy tower in 60 seconds!

levels.name: The Gauntlet
levels.tagline: Six obstacle stations back to back - doors, wrecking balls, a sweeper, bumpers. Run it!
levels.label: Obstacles

levels.name: Colour Rush
levels.tagline: Stand on the colour the sign SAYS - not the colour it is written in. Think fast!
levels.label: Brain

levels.name: Hop Skip
levels.tagline: No floor, only stepping stones - hop your way across three stretches to the finish!
levels.label: Jump race

levels.name: Potato Party
levels.tagline: Tiny arena, belts round the edge, bombs for almost half the lobby. Pass it on!
levels.label: Hot potato

levels.name: Splat Arena
levels.tagline: A bigger canvas, two sweepers, two gold doodles. Paint the most before the buzzer!
levels.label: Paint party

levels.name: Jump Club
levels.tagline: Jump the spinning bar every time it comes round - it only gets faster. Survive 60s!
levels.label: Jump

levels.name: Odd One Out
levels.tagline: Remember the board, then stand where the sign’s symbol was NOT. Most tiles had it!
levels.label: Brain

levels.name: Spike Sprint
levels.tagline: A corridor of pop-up spikes. Read the rhythm - stop, go, stop - and sprint to the end!
levels.label: Obstacles

levels.name: Crown Tower
levels.tagline: The crown hops between three towers and the floor every 8s. Climb, drop, shove - 30s wins!
levels.label: King of the hill

levels.name: Sumo Smash
levels.tagline: Bumpers everywhere and the ring is shrinking. Shove, bounce, survive 50 seconds!
levels.label: Sumo

levels.name: Tip Toe Towers
levels.tagline: Three hidden-path grids, each trickier than the last. Trust the mint tiles!
levels.label: Hidden path

levels.name: Door Dash Deluxe
levels.tagline: Seven rows of lucky doors, down to one real door of three. Trouble in every gap!
levels.label: Lucky doors

achievements.title: Podium Regular
achievements.description: Finish in the top 3 ten times.

achievements.title: Bot Tamer
achievements.description: Win a round against hard bots.

achievements.title: World Tour
achievements.description: Qualify in every round at least once.

achievements.title: Trendsetter
achievements.description: Buy 5 hats, emotes, entrances or trails.
